title: File Reference
description: A reference to an external file. Files **MAY** be referenced by an URI (or IRI) or a buffer view index.

aliases.description: An array of aliases used for files within this external file. Aliases allow overriding inner file URIs.

bufferView.description: The index of the bufferView that contains the file data.
bufferView.gltf_detailedDescription: The index of the bufferView that contains the file data. This field **MUST NOT** be defined when `uri` is defined.

mimeType.description: The media type or MIME type of the external file.
mimeType.gltf_detailedDescription: The media type or MIME type of the external file. This field is required and **MUST** always be defined.

uri.description: The URI (or IRI) of the external file.
uri.gltf_detailedDescription: The URI (or IRI) of the external file.  Relative paths are relative to the current glTF asset.  Instead of referencing an external file, this field **MAY** contain a `data:`-URI. This field **MUST NOT** be defined when `bufferView` is defined.
